meta.guide_tau: Level caption:  energy (NIST, or a measurement of the last 20 years where one exists) and measured lifetime (where one exists).
meta.notes: All transition A_s and branching values are CALCULATED (MCDHF, Hartman et al. 2010, Table III) and marked method 'theory'; they are not measurements. Rows flagged in the paper as affected by convergence problems (upper levels 5d 4P1/2, 4D1/2, 4D5/2) were left out. Lifetimes with method 'experiment' are the laser measurements of Hartman et al.; those with method 'compilation' are older beam-foil / delayed-coincidence values read in Hartman's Table II (originals not opened). Hyperfine constants of the 5p3 2D, 2P levels are for 121Sb and are second-hand (read in Liu et al. 2023, units MHz as printed there). Wavelengths in labels are those printed by Hartman et al. (air above 200 nm, vacuum below). Lechner et al. give A and B for both hyperfine-split levels of the 217.6 nm line for 112-133Sb; only the stable isotopes are recorded here.
